questions.question: Which management tool provides a web-based graphical interface with customisable dashboards for managing Azure?
questions.explanation: The Azure portal is the browser-based GUI with dashboards.

questions.question: Which statement about Azure Cloud Shell is correct?

options.text: It is a browser-based shell that offers both Bash and PowerShell, already authenticated to your account
It must be installed on a local computer

questions.explanation: Cloud Shell gives Azure CLI and Azure PowerShell in the browser with no installation.

questions.question: An administrator prefers commands such as `New-AzVM` and `Get-AzResourceGroup`. Which tool is this?

options.why: Correct. It uses verb-noun cmdlets from the Az module.
The CLI uses commands such as `az vm create`.

questions.explanation: Azure PowerShell uses cmdlets (verb-noun); Azure CLI uses `az` commands.

questions.scenario: A company wants to apply Azure Policy and Microsoft Defender for Cloud to Linux servers running in its own datacenter and in another cloud provider.
questions.question: Which service makes this possible?

options.why: Correct. Arc projects external servers into Azure Resource Manager.

questions.explanation: Azure Arc extends Azure management, governance and security to resources outside Azure.

questions.question: Which TWO are benefits of infrastructure as code (IaC)?

options.text: Environments can be deployed consistently and repeatedly
It removes the need for any testing
options.why: Code should still be tested and reviewed.

options.text: Infrastructure definitions can be stored in source control and reviewed
It only works with on-premises servers
options.why: IaC is widely used in the cloud.

questions.explanation: IaC makes infrastructure repeatable, versioned and reviewable. Examples are Bicep, ARM templates and Terraform.

questions.question: What is Azure Resource Manager (ARM)?

options.text: The deployment and management service through which all Azure management requests are processed

options.why: ARM is a core Azure service.

questions.explanation: Portal, CLI, PowerShell, REST and templates all go through ARM, which provides consistent authentication, RBAC, policy and tagging.

questions.question: ARM templates are written in which format, and what style are they?

options.why: Correct. You describe what you want, not how to build it.
ARM templates are JSON and declarative.

questions.explanation: ARM templates are declarative JSON files. Bicep is a simpler language that compiles to ARM templates.

questions.question: Which service analyses your deployed resources and provides personalised recommendations to improve reliability, security, performance, operational excellence and cost?

options.why: Service Health reports Azure service issues.
The calculator estimates costs before deployment.

questions.explanation: Advisor gives recommendations across five categories, aligned with the Well-Architected Framework.

questions.scenario: You want to be notified about Azure service incidents and planned maintenance that affect the specific regions and services your subscription uses.
questions.question: Which service should you use?

options.why: Correct. It gives a personalised view of service issues and maintenance.

questions.explanation: Azure status is global; Service Health is personalised to your services and regions; Resource Health covers individual resources.

questions.question: Which component of Azure Service Health shows the health of an individual resource, such as a specific virtual machine?

options.why: Azure status is a global view of all Azure services.

questions.explanation: Service Health includes Azure status (global), Service Health (your services) and Resource Health (your resources).

questions.question: Which tool in Azure Monitor lets you write queries, using Kusto Query Language (KQL), against collected log data?

options.why: Advisor does not run log queries.

questions.explanation: Log Analytics is the Azure Monitor tool for editing and running KQL log queries.

questions.question: Which Azure Monitor feature monitors live web applications, tracking request rates, response times, failures and dependencies?

options.why: Service Health tracks Azure platform issues.

questions.explanation: Application Insights is Azure Monitor's application performance monitoring (APM) feature.

questions.scenario: An operations team wants an email and SMS when a VM's CPU stays above 90% for 15 minutes.
questions.question: What should they configure?

options.text: An Azure Monitor alert rule with an action group

options.why: Budgets alert on cost, not CPU.

questions.explanation: Azure Monitor alerts evaluate metrics or logs and notify through action groups (email, SMS, webhooks and more).

questions.question: What is Bicep?

options.text: A domain-specific language for declaratively deploying Azure resources, simpler than ARM JSON

questions.explanation: Bicep is an infrastructure-as-code language that compiles to ARM templates.
